Definition: from G4862 and G1392; to exalt to dignity in company (i.e. similarly) with:--glorify together.
BiblicalUsage: The glorifying is shared because the suffering was shared: Paul says if we are children then we are heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if we suffer with Him, that we may also be glorified together. And the together is the promise: no solitary glory, but glory with Him.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that glory with Christ follows suffering with Him, and I hold that the together is as much the promise as the glory.
